tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Divergence of the Weyl Tensor] ↗ prop:contracted-bianchi-identities 1. ch7:7.32

On every Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian $n$-manifold with $n\geq 3$, egin{equation} \operatorname {tr}_g( abla W)=(n-3)C, ag {7.50} \end{equation} where the trace is on the first and last indices of $ abla W$.

Proof

\sketch Differentiate $W=\mathrm{Rm}-P\owedge g$ and use the first contracted Bianchi identity to obtain

egin{equation} W_{ijkl;i}=R_{jk;l}-R_{jl;k}-P_{il;i}g_{jk}-P_{jk;i}g_{il} +P_{ik;i}g_{jl}+P_{jl;i}g_{ik}. ag {7.51} \end{equation}

The second contracted Bianchi identity and the definition of $P$ give

\[ P_{il;i}= rac1{2(n-1)}S_{;l}, \qquad P_{ik;i}= rac1{2(n-1)}S_{;k}. \]

Substitution into (7.51) yields

\[ W_{ijkl;i}=(n-3)(P_{jk;l}-P_{jl;k})=(n-3)C_{jkl}. \]

□
